results.name: Elected Council
results.description: Prominent members of the community were chosen to lead the city collectively.

results.name: Mayor
results.description: The locals democratically voted for their current leader.

results.name: Hereditary
results.description: A non-elected leader is in power, by virtue of their bloodline.

results.name: Merchant Monarch
results.description: The wealthiest merchant in the city leads by default. (Regardless of population wealth, they are, at least, considered wealthy.) (When rolling districts, choose ‘Market District’ as one of them)

results.name: Military Officer
results.description: The city is controlled by a current or ex-leader of a military group. (+1 to law enforcement roll)

results.name: Oligarchy
results.description: A few top individuals hold sway, collectively, over the city. [Roll 1d4]: 1: merchants (plutocracy); 2: mages (magocracy); 3: priests (theocracy); 4: other small group. (When rolling districts, choose one that best fits your leadership as one of them)

results.name: Underworld or Criminal Enterprise
results.description: A criminal, or group of criminals, either publicly, or privately, controls the city. (-2 to general crime roll) (Roll on organized crime table regardless of general crime table result)

results.name: Anarcho-Syndicalist Commune
results.description: The members of the city take turns as a sort of executive officer for the week.
